cobblebrain.config.api_key.tooltip:
The API key used for authentication with the AI system. 
It can be a Bearer token or a Google API key depending on the provider.
cobblebrain.config.key_rotation.tooltip:
Enables API key rotation when errors occur. 
Useful for handling invalid or expired keys.
List of HTTP status codes that trigger key rotation. 
Defines error conditions for switching keys.
cobblebrain.config.api_base_url.tooltip:
The base URL of the API endpoint. 
Examples include 
- OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api
- Google AI Studio: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com
- Or a local LM Studio server.
cobblebrain.config.use_chat_endpoint.too:
Automatically includes '/v1/chat/completions' in the ApiBaseUrl address.
Disable it if you are having trouble accessing your AI API
cobblebrain.config.local_api_provider.to:
If apiBaseUrl is a local address (127.0.0.1),
The system uses the provider name to adapt messages for the correct provider. 
Officially supported providers: player2, lmstudio
cobblebrain.config.ai_model.tooltip:
The names of the AI models to use.
Examples are gemini-2.5-flash, gemma-3-12b-it
cobblebrain.config.model_rotation.toolti:
Enables model rotation when errors occur.
Useful for fallback to alternative models.
cobblebrain.config.model_rotation_trigge:
List of HTTP status codes that trigger model rotation.
Defines error conditions for switching models.
cobblebrain.config.ai_provider.tooltip:
A provider hint used for routing in OpenRouter. 
This is ignored when using other provider.
cobblebrain.config.reasoning_effort.tool:
Defines the reasoning effort level for supported models.
Options include high, medium, low, auto, or none.
cobblebrain.config.request_timeout.toolt:
Defines the request timeout in seconds.
Local models may require longer values.
cobblebrain.config.debug_logging.tooltip:
Enables debug logging for troubleshooting.
Logs are stored in the cobblebrain-ai/logs directory.
cobblebrain.config.ignore_hunger.tooltip:
Makes the AI ignore any information about the Pokémon's hunger.
Adding a new rule to the AI's instructions
cobblebrain.config.use_default_output.to:
Uses the recommended and updated OUTPUT FORMAT of the mod version.
Only disable it if you want to apply your own CUSTOM OUTPUT, 
Which is not recommended.
cobblebrain.config.selected_language.too:
The language the AI uses for responses.
Determines dialogue output language.
cobblebrain.config.preferred_name.toolti: Defines how the AI and Pokémon should call you during conversations.
cobblebrain.config.offline_mode.tooltip: Enables Offline Mode. Disables AI requests and prompt building.
cobblebrain.config.offline_talk_mode.too: Enables generating responses locally via the offline dialogue system when sending messages.
cobblebrain.config.psychic_translation.t: When enabled, Psychic-type Pokémon may occasionally interpret another Pokémon's emotions or intentions during conversation, instead of translating them literally.
cobblebrain.config.max_interaction_saves:
The maximum number of recent conversation messages kept as short-term context, it helps the AI maintain conversation continuity.
 Higher values use more tokens and may increase response time.
cobblebrain.config.dialogue_in_chat.tool:
Shows generated dialogue directly in the chat.
This makes Pokémon conversations visible to players.
cobblebrain.config.chatbubbles.tooltip:
Enables chat bubbles above characters.
Dialogue will appear visually instead of only in text chat.
cobblebrain.config.needs_pokemon_transla:
When active, Pokémon speak normally if the player has the Exp Share equipped on themselves.
If not equiped, the Pokémon speak like animals.
This setting takes priority over 'outputDialogue' and 'outputCanonLanguage'
cobblebrain.config.allow_pokemon_pvp.too:
Allows Pokémon to attack other players’ Pokémon.
Disabling prevents player-versus-player battles.
cobblebrain.config.allow_pokemon_pve.too:
Allows Pokémon to attack mobs in the world.
Exceptions include tamed mobs and non-aggressive tagged mobs.
cobblebrain.config.enable_karma.tooltip:
Enables karma gain/loss and karma-based mechanics.
If disabled, stored karma values stay unchanged and karma-based rewards/raids are turned off.
cobblebrain.config.schedule_raid.tooltip:
Determines if raids can be created in the world.
Raids can happen when your karma with a species falls below -11
cobblebrain.config.characteristics.toolt:
list to define characteristics of a specific Pokémon for the AI.
Format: <pokemonName>: <text>
cobblebrain.config.low_token_mode.toolti:
Reduces world information sent to the AI.
This helps conserve tokens and lower usage costs.
cobblebrain.config.dialogue_on_damage.to:
Makes Pokémon speak when someone is hurt.
Dialogue is triggered by damage events.
cobblebrain.config.dialogue_on_battle.to:
Makes Pokémon speak during battle events.
Dialogue reflects combat situations.
cobblebrain.config.wild_pokemon_talk_cha:
Sets the chance of wild pokemon to participate in dialogue, not generate new ones. 
Wild Pokémon may speak randomly during ongoing dialogues.
cobblebrain.config.wild_quest_chance.too:
Set the chance for a Pokémon to start a quest when you have a dialogue with wild Pokémon. 
The quests can be of the type BATTLE, ITEM, or ADVICE.
cobblebrain.config.spontaneous_dialogue_:
Sets the chance of spontaneous dialogue.
Pokémon may speak randomly during idle moments.
cobblebrain.config.listen_to_chat.toolti:
Enables listening to regular player chat.
If disabled, the AI ignores non-command messages.
cobblebrain.config.only_nearby_chat.tool:
Restricts listening to nearby players only.
Works only if listenToChat is enabled.
cobblebrain.config.max_stored_memories.t: Maximum stored memory size per Pokémon in jsonl files.
cobblebrain.config.max_relevant_memories: Maximum relevant memories retrieved and sent in the prompt.
cobblebrain.config.last_retrieved_memory: Maximum size of the cache of recently used/retrieved memories.
Number of interactions a retrieved memory stays in the cache.
cobblebrain.config.decrease_friendship.t:
Dialogue can decrease friendship with players.
Used for negative interactions.
cobblebrain.config.increase_friendship.t:
Dialogue can increase friendship with players.
Used for positive interactions.
cobblebrain.config.show_friendship.toolt:
Displays friendship values in chat.
Players can see relationship changes.
cobblebrain.config.instruct.tooltip:
The Instructs as a whole works as a global prompt.
Defines how the AI or Pokemon behave, think and responds.
Each instruct (item on the list) shapes how the response is sent
cobblebrain.config.output_dialogue.toolt:
Enables the Pokémon to generate natural language dialogue,
Allowing them to dialogue with the player.
cobblebrain.config.output_actions.toolti:
Enables Pokémon to perform specialized actions based on the situation or the player command,
such as cooking food, growing berries, or eating items.
cobblebrain.config.output_friendship.too:
Enables the AI to manage and update friendship levels based on your interactions,
influencing the Pokémon's loyalty and behavior.
Provides the AI with information about the current environment
 (like time of day, biome, player status and etc...) for more contextual responses.
cobblebrain.config.output_guaranteed_cat:
Enables the possibility of wild Pokémon to be convinced via dialogue to join you,
with a 100% capture rate in the next Poké Ball throw.
cobblebrain.config.output_mobs_context.t:
Gives the AI awareness of nearby non-Pokémon entities,
allowing it to react to the presence of other mobs in the area.
cobblebrain.config.output_quests.tooltip:
Enables the automated quest system, allowing Pokémon
to offer tasks and rewards to the player.
cobblebrain.config.output_april1.tooltip:
Activates special 'April Fools' actions (e.g nuke, imaginary technique).
Most of the actions are destructive so be careful!
cobblebrain.config.output_pokemon_langua:
Makes Pokémon speak using their iconic vocalizations (e.g., 'Pika Pika')
instead of human speech. Automatically deactivates outputDialogue when in use.
cobblebrain.config.output_memories.toolt: Allows the AI to store and recall past interactions.
cobblebrain.action.desc.cook: Can cook food and smelt ores. 5% chance of item turning into charcoal.
cobblebrain.action.desc.repair: Repairs tools and weapons up to a certain durability threshold.
cobblebrain.action.desc.shift: Player becomes invisible, gains increased speed and jump height, but suffers from high weakness.
cobblebrain.action.desc.fish: Searches nearby waters for fish and other resources.
cobblebrain.action.desc.nightmare: Inflicts fear on nearby creatures, causing them to flee in panic.
cobblebrain.action.desc.light: Creates a temporary light source and illuminates dark areas.
cobblebrain.action.desc.scout: Performs aerial reconnaissance and reports nearby structures and entities.
cobblebrain.action.desc.teleport: Teleports the trainer to the currently marked location.
cobblebrain.action.desc.attack: Pokémon attacks any mob close to it; it will stop after killing the target.
cobblebrain.action.desc.protect: Pokémon targets hostile mobs nearest to the player; if none are found, it follows the player.
cobblebrain.action.desc.eat: Pokémon eat any edible item dropped on the ground. Some foods and berries may grant temporary effects.
cobblebrain.action.desc.buff: Pokémon grants the player a positive status effect based on its type.
cobblebrain.action.desc.debuff_enemy: Pokémon applies a negative status effect to nearby mobs based on its primary type.
cobblebrain.action.desc.sit: Pokémon stays fixed in place, ignoring other actions.
cobblebrain.action.desc.idle: Pokémon cancels all active commands and returns to normal behavior.

cobblebrain.summary.offline_unavailable: Session summary is not available in Offline Mode.

cobblebrain.only_nearby_messages.warning: There are no nearby players to hear your message.
cobblebrain.quest.interrupt_warning: Wait! The Pokémon is about to say something about the mission. Send the message again if you want to interrupt it anyway.
cobblebrain.quest.item_success: Quest Success! You delivered the %s to %s.
cobblebrain.quest.treasure_success: Treasure Found! %s is happy you found it!
cobblebrain.quest.advice_success: Quest Success! %s is very happy with your advice.
cobblebrain.quest.advice_failed: Quest Failed! %s was offended or ignored your advice.
cobblebrain.quest.no_active_to_abandon: You don't have any active secondary quest to abandon.
cobblebrain.quest.xp_reward: You gained %s XP for completing the quest!
cobblebrain.quest.treasure_failed.self: Quest Failed! You destroyed the item storage.
cobblebrain.quest.treasure_failed.other: Quest Failed! Someone else destroyed or stole the items.
cobblebrain.team.thinking: Your team is thinking about something to say...
cobblebrain.pokemon.convinced: The Pokémon %s seems convinced to join you!
cobblebrain.raid.defeated: You were defeated... The Pokémon seem to calm down...
cobblebrain.raid.survived: You survived the raid. The Pokémon seem to calm down...
